title: ULTRA's heavy-loop exception no longer falls back to a real single-pass DEEP brief — it now returns an honest ok:false failure with no brief
repro: In-process, candidate sha 1006c6da694ede5776c3dabbd27b305aeb56b5ad, sidecar/services/research/iter.run_heavy_research(query, target=<bound India ResearchTarget KAYNES.NS>, bound=True, angles=3, tool_call=<stub>, llm_call=<stub>, budget=BudgetGuard(...)) with services.research.disclosures.gather_floor patched (unittest.mock.patch.object) to raise RuntimeError. Then mirrored deep_research.py's own except-wrap around that exact call (deep_research.py:296-298: `except Exception as exc: return _loop_failed("heavy", exc)`), which is the real user-facing code path (services/agent_tools/deep_research.py _run_loop -> run_deep_brief).
